title: Perfect complexes over a commutative ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. An object $C\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is perfect if it is isomorphic in $D(R)$ to a bounded cochain complex of finitely generated projective $R$-modules.
